caption: The drawing depicts a single intricately-shaped metallic object positioned vertically on a plain, off-white background. The object is predominantly rendered in bronze and steel tones, with highlights and shading to emphasize its three-dimensional form and metallic texture. It features two opposing, ornate, S-shaped curves with various attached mechanical components. Among these components are multiple small wheels with spokes arranged at different points along the curves, a winged element, rectangles with fine details, and what appears to be a wrench or spanner at the top-most part. The drawing does not contain any other objects or background details, focusing entirely on the central object and its structural elements.
title: Spanish Bit
